assetCoverage.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, the Company's asset coverage ratio was 158%.

waYieldAtCost.sentence: Weighted average total yield of debt and income producing securities(1) | 11.95 | % | 11.30 | %
waYieldAtCost.label: Weighted average total yield of debt and income producing securities(1)
waYieldAtCost.note: The weighted average yield of our debt and income producing securities is not the same as a return on investment for our stockholders but, rather, relates to a portion of our investment portfolio and is calculated before the payment of our fees and expenses. There can be no assurance that the weighted average yield will remain at its current level. Amounts in this table exclude short-term investments.
